method: SVG guide + AI graphite; targeted mouth/septa edits

alt.en: Oblique cutaway of a coral polyp: twelve tentacles on the oral-disc rim, a small oval mouth and six thin radial septa in the skeletal cup.
alt.zh: 珊瑚虫的斜剖面：口盘边缘有十二根触手，中央是小椭圆口，骨骼杯内有六片薄的放射状隔片。

caption.en: Twelve rim tentacles surround the mouth; the open cup reveals six radial skeletal septa.
caption.zh: 十二根边缘触手围绕口部；剖开的骨骼杯露出六片放射状骨骼隔片。

checks: Count twelve distinct tentacles, each rooted on the oral-disc rim outside and above the cutaway; no tentacle grows inside the cup.
Check one small horizontal oval mouth without nested eye-like markings, and six thin radial septa attached to the cup floor and wall.
Trace the continuous cup wall and oblique cut edges; septa have thin laminar edges, not teeth or fangs.

method: Targeted AI edit of original anatomy

alt.en: Mid-sagittal swallowing section: the tongue pushes a bolus back beneath the raised soft palate; the epiglottis covers the larynx and food enters the oesophagus behind the ringed trachea.
alt.zh: 吞咽的正中矢状剖面：舌将食团推向后方抬起的软腭之下；会厌盖住喉口，食物进入环状气管后方的食道。

caption.en: The raised soft palate closes the nasal route. The folded epiglottis covers the larynx as the bolus enters the oesophagus behind the trachea.
caption.zh: 抬起的软腭封住通往鼻腔的路径；会厌翻下盖住喉口，食团进入气管后方的食道。

checks: Check a clean mid-sagittal section with the tongue pushing one bolus posteriorly and the soft palate raised against the posterior pharyngeal wall.
Follow the food into the oesophagus behind the ringed trachea; the rooted, folded epiglottis covers the laryngeal inlet.
Inspect embedded teeth and a smooth continuous posterior neck outline: no floating tooth or external vertebral spikes.

method: Original grounded graphite blocks + asserted SVG overlay + local graphite material edit

alt.en: Three grounded plate-boundary blocks: divergent arrows point apart, convergent arrows point together above a subducting slab, and transform arrows follow a fault across which a reference band is offset.
alt.zh: 三块有连续基底的板块边界模型：分离箭头背向，汇聚箭头相向且下方有俯冲板片；转换箭头沿断层相反运动，参照带在断层两侧错开。

caption.en: Divergence, convergence with subduction, and transform motion. Opposing arrows show motion; the displaced band marks sideways offset.
caption.zh: 分离、伴随俯冲的汇聚，以及转换运动。相反的箭头表示运动，错开的参照带显示水平位移。

checks: Check all three original grounded block bodies retain continuous bases and cut faces; no slab floats above a base.
Check outward divergence arrows and inward convergence arrows; follow the descending slab beneath the opposing plate.
Check the transform arrows are opposite and parallel to the fault, and the same reference band meets the fault at visibly separated positions.

method: SVG particle/composition guide + targeted AI edit of original cloud

alt.en: A cut-open cumulonimbus with a broad anvil: six enlarged hexagonal ice crystals above a faint freezing line, six round droplets below, and slanting rain shafts beneath the base.
alt.zh: 剖开的砧状积雨云：淡淡的冻结线之上有六枚放大的六角冰晶，之下有六颗圆水滴，云底下方是倾斜的雨丝。

caption.en: Ice crystals lie above the faint 0 °C guide and liquid droplets below it; rain falls beneath the cloud. The particles are enlarged.
caption.zh: 淡淡的 0 ℃ 参考线之上是冰晶，之下是液态水滴；云底下方降雨。粒子已放大。

checks: Count six distinct hexagonal ice crystals above the freezing line and six distinct round liquid drops below it.
Check a real billowing tower and broad anvil, not a rectangular box or a solid shell.
Check the faint horizontal guide separates the two phase groups and separate slanted rain shafts emerge beneath the cloud.

method: Manual PD Du tally contour trace + AI graphite rendering

alt.en: Two longitudinal halves of a bronze Du tiger tally: an outer flank above and a flat hatched mating face below, both with a blunt feline muzzle, short legs and curled tail; all inscription fields are blank.
alt.zh: 青铜杜虎符的纵分两半：上方为外侧虎身，下方为平整排线的配合面；两半都有短钝虎吻、短腿和卷尾，铭文位置全部留白。

caption.en: The Du tiger tally splits lengthwise into matching halves. Its inscription field is left blank.
caption.zh: 杜虎符沿纵向分成相互吻合的两半，铭文位置留白。

checks: Compare the blunt muzzle, short legs, broad paws, hip and curling tail against Gary Todd’s CC0 Du tally photograph; both halves share the traced silhouette.
Check exactly two half-thickness longitudinal pieces: upper sculpted flank with narrow seam edge, lower flat mating face; not two complete animals.
Inspect both flanks and mating plane for blank inscription fields: no characters, pseudo-writing or copied photo inscriptions.

method: Asserted SVG exploded guide + AI graphite style transfer

alt.en: Opened guo housing below an exploded ancient bronze mechanism: an integrated wangshan sight and ya catch at left, a gouxin sear across the middle, a long xuandao trigger at right, and two withdrawn pins with assembly guides.
alt.zh: 剖开的郭位于青铜弩机分解部件下方：左侧是一体的望山与牙，中间是钩心，右侧是长悬刀，另有两枚抽出的销钉与装配引线。

caption.en: The xuandao trigger releases the gouxin sear, which releases the ya catch below the wangshan sight. Two pins locate the moving parts in the guo housing.
caption.zh: 悬刀释放钩心，钩心再释放望山下的牙。两枚销钉将活动部件定位在郭中。

checks: Count one guo housing, three moving members (integrated wangshan/ya, gouxin and xuandao) and exactly two withdrawn pins.
Follow trigger → sear → catch through the adjacent contact faces and motion arrows; dashed assembly guides align the pins with the two pivot bores.
Compare the sight/catch and long trigger silhouettes against the CC0 museum reference; no comb-like row of teeth, extra spring or invented decorative writing.

method: Asserted structural guide + AI graphite edit of original chariot

alt.en: Two stocky horses draw a small square chariot box on a centred axle and two large many-spoked wheels; one curved central pole meets a crossbar with two yoke-saddles seated on it.
alt.zh: 两匹矮壮马牵引小方形车舆，车轴位于车舆中央下方，两侧为多辐大轮；一根弯曲的中央车辀连接横衡，横衡上坐落两具轭。

caption.en: One curved central pole joins the crossbar. Its two seated yoke-saddles rest over the horses’ necks; the axle supports the middle of the small box.
caption.zh: 一根弯曲的中央车辀连接横衡，两具轭坐在横衡上并架于马颈；车轴支撑小车舆的中央。

checks: Count two stocky horses, one small near-square box, two large many-spoked wheels, one centred axle and one curved central pole.
Follow the single pole continuously to the transverse crossbar and check both yoke-saddles are seated on it and rest over the horses’ necks.
Inspect wheel/box alignment and joined harness structure; no floating yoke, breast medallion, modern breast collar or side traces.

method: Glyph removal ONLY: targeted AI edit of original

alt.en: Graphite drawing of a bronze capacity measure with one rectangular cavity and straight handle beside eight bamboo slips joined by two cords; all surfaces are uninscribed.
alt.zh: 石墨画中的青铜量器带一处长方形容腔和直柄，旁边八枚竹简用两道绳编连；所有表面均无字。

caption.en: A bronze capacity measure beside eight bamboo slips bound with two cords, with plain uninscribed surfaces.
caption.zh: 青铜量器旁是以两道绳编连的八枚竹简，表面均留白无字。

checks: Compare with the original: same cavity, rim, handle, eight strips, two cords, frayed ends, perspective and layout.
Inspect every strip, the measure front, inner walls and handle at 2×: all fake glyphs are removed and surfaces remain uninscribed.
Check surrounding graphite material modelling and contours are retained; this is a local glyph-removal edit, not a replacement design.

method: PD/CC photograph trace + asserted nine-bay guide + AI graphite

alt.en: Marina Barrage from the sea side: nine broad steel crest gates partly lowered beneath a low deck with thin overflow, the bowed pump-building roof and grassy ramp at right, and the Singapore skyline behind.
alt.zh: 从海侧看滨海堤坝：低矮步行桥下九扇宽钢制翻板闸门部分放倒，水流薄薄漫过；右侧是泵房的弧形屋顶与草坡，后方为新加坡天际线。

caption.en: Marina Barrage’s nine crest gates release water in a shallow overflow. The curved pump building and grass-covered roof ramp stand beside the barrage.
caption.zh: 滨海堤坝九扇翻板闸门以浅薄溢流排水；弧形泵房与覆草屋顶坡道位于堤坝一旁。

checks: Count exactly nine broad steel crest-gate bays beneath a low continuous deck; each leaf is visible and partly lowered, with only a thin overflow.
Compare the bowed roof, glazed end, open columns and planted roof ramp with the CC0/CC-BY-SA site photographs, and the skyline with the roof-view photograph.
Check a long low barrage, reservoir and distant skyline: no high dam, deep spillway, tall waterfall, signage or invented lettering.

method: Asserted SVG section guide + AI graphite restyle

alt.en: A graphite reef section beneath a horizontal sea surface: shallow reef flat at left, a raised wave-washed crest in the middle and a descending slope at right, separated by two dashed guides.
alt.zh: 水平海面下的石墨礁区剖面：左侧浅平礁坪、中间受浪冲刷的礁脊、右侧向深处下降的礁坡，以两条虚线分隔。

caption.en: From left to right: reef flat, reef crest and reef slope. Dashed guides separate the three zones; the arrow marks deeper water on the slope.
caption.zh: 从左到右为礁坪、礁脊和礁坡；虚线分隔三区，箭头显示礁坡水深增加。

checks: Count three bracketed zones separated by two dashed guides; horizontal sea surface stays above the flat and crest.
Follow the shallow flat, rounded wave-washed crest and continuous slope down into deeper right-hand water.
Check rooted coral silhouettes, fine limestone bedding and layered pencil hatching; no floating coral or flat noise-textured block.

method: Asserted shallow-water SVG guide + AI graphite restyle

alt.en: Graphite ocean section: low widely spaced waves over deep water become taller and closer together as the seabed rises to the right-hand coast; a dashed line marks still sea level.
alt.zh: 石墨海洋剖面：深水中的低矮长波，随着海床向右侧海岸抬升而变高、变密；虚线表示静水面。

caption.en: Towards the coast, tsunami waves slow, shorten and grow higher. The section exaggerates vertical scale.
caption.zh: 海啸波向岸传播时减速、波长缩短、波高增大；剖面的竖直比例经过夸张。

checks: Follow low long deep-water waves becoming distinctly taller and closer together towards the right-hand coast.
Check a continuous rising seabed, exposed dry coast and dashed still-water line; every trough remains above the seabed.
Check two rightward travel arrows, deep/shallow depth comparison and layered graphite section hatching; mathematical guide asserts decreasing depth, growing amplitude and shortening wavelength.
